Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires are out in the middle and they are followed by the India Women players. Laura Wolvaardt will open the innings for South Africa Women alongside Tazmin Brits. It will be Deepti Sharma to get proceedings underway with the ball here.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, just 110 runs are needed for South Africa Women to win the Tri-Series but it won't be easy given the nature of the pitch and the quality of the Indian spinners. Can they chase it down? We shall find out shortly. We shall be back with the second innings soon.

South Africa Women will be pleased with their bowling effort. Shabnim Ismail and Nonkululeko Mlaba started off brilliantly with the ball. Mlaba was successful with two big scalps while Ismail kept it economical from the other end. Ayabonga Khaka and skipper Sune Luus chipped in with one a piece to cap off an excellent effort with the ball by Proteas Women.

India Women have ended on a below-par total of 109 for 4 in their 20 overs in the Final. Opting to bat first, India lost Smriti Mandhana and Jemimah Rodrigues for not much. Harleen Deol added 48 for the 3rd wicket with skipper Harmanpreet Kaur with the latter doing the bulk of the work. The scoring was difficult for India Women as they were 69 for 3 at the 15-over mark when Kaur departed for 21. Deepti Sharma came in at number 5 and gave some impetus to the innings with 16*. She added 39 runs off 28 balls along with Deol. Harleen Deol almost batted through the innings and carried the team along with a sensible 46 on this tough wicket to bat. India will hope for their bowlers to step up and make a match out of this.
Keeps it full and wide, Pooja Vastrakar strokes it straight to cover and gets across for the single. India Women finish with 109/4 on the board!
Excellent delivery! Ayabonga Khaka nails the wide yorker and Pooja Vastrakar fails to get any bat on it.
Pooja Vastrakar walks in next.

OUT! TIMBER! Ayabonga Khaka has the last laugh here. Khaka goes pace on and bowls wicket-to-wicket. Harleen Deol backs away and looks to slap it through covers but the ball skids through and bates the bat before crashing into middle and leg stump. Deol departs 4 runs short off her half-century and Khaka gets her first wicket of the game.
FOUR! Nicely done! Full and outside off, Harleen Deol just opens the bat face at the last moment and guides it wide of short third man for a boundary.
This is right in the blockhole around leg stump, Deepti Sharma backs away and flicks it away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Starts off with a full toss on the legs, Deepti Sharma whips it away past square leg and races back for the second.
Ayabonga Khaka (2-0-9-0) to bowl the final over of the innings.
Back of a length over middle and leg, this is pulled away through mid-wicket for one.

DROPPED! Short of a length around middle, Harleen Deol looks to get inside the line and pull but takes her eyes off the ball and ends up sticking her bat out. The ball flies just over short fine leg where the fielder leaps up and spills the catch. A single is taken.
This is dug in short and around off, Deepti Sharma pulls it over mid off for a single.
FOUR! Smashed away! This is pitched up on leg stump, Deepti Sharma backs away and opens up the off side before hammering it through extra cover for a boundary.
Pacy delivery, around the top of off and zipping through. Deepti Sharma looks to guide it fine but is well beaten.
Slower and shorter outside off, Harleen Deol taps it toward cover-point and scampers through for the quick single.
WIDE! A length ball, angling just down the leg side and a wide is called.
Shabnim Ismail (2-2-0-0) is back on.
Quicker and shorter on off stump, this is pulled away through mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up around off, Deepti Sharma advances and slogs it toward deep mid-wicket for only a single.
Flatter and on the pads, jabbed away past square leg for a single.
THREE WIDES! Quicker and angling down the leg, another attempted scoop from Deepti Sharma but she misses. The ball goes toward fine leg and they get a single in addition to the wide.
Harleen Deol comes charging down the track to a shortish delivery and mistimes the pull toward mid-wicket for a run.
Full and around middle, heaved away in front of deep mid-wicket for just a single.
TWO WIDES! This is fired in full and down the leg side, the keeper spills it as well and they get across for the single.
Leg bye! Flatter delivery, angling in from outside off, Deepti Sharma gets inside the line and looks to scoop it away. The ball goes off her arms and toward short third man. They get a leg bye.
FOUR! This is the flipper but on leg stump, Harleen Deol shuffles across and pulls it hard into the backward square leg fence. A much-needed boundary for India Women.
Sune Luus sees Harleen Deol advancing and bowls it short and well outside the off stump. Deol manages to reach it and plays it toward cover.
Around middle, Deepti Sharma steps out and chips it down the ground for a run.
Around middle, swept up aerially and down to deep backward square leg for a single.
Charging down the track here and Sune Luus pulls the length back a long way. Harleen Deol does well to adjust and keep it out.
Tossed up full and outside off, Deepti Sharma advances and drives it toward wide long off for a single.
On a length again outside off, Deepti Sharma shuffles a bit and works it in front of mid-wicket for a run. They look for the second but won't get it.
Five single on the trot now. Flatter and on the pads, this is tucked away through square leg for one.
On a length and turning in from outside off, Deepti Sharma works it through mid-wicket for one more.
Shorter and outside off, turning away. Deol taps it in front of point and picks up a single.
Drops it short and outside off, Deepti Sharma pulls it down to long on and turns the strike over.
Flatter delivery, angled into leg stump, Harleen Deol tucks it leg side for a single.
Deepti Sharma is the new batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! Captain to captain and Sune Luus picks up the big wicket of Harmanpreet Kaur. Nicely tossed up on a length around off, Kaur looks to step out and go downtown but gets beaten in the flight. The ball turns away as well and betas the outside edge. Sinalo Jafta is quick to whip off the bails and Kaur is a long way out. South Africa Women in cruise control here.
Commentary.Howout: st Sinalo Jafta b Sune Luus

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and on middle, pulled away in front of mid-wicket for one.
Overthrows! Around off, pushed away to cover for a quick single. Chloe Tryon over there fires in a loopy throw toward the bowler's end but it is off target and they get an extra run.
Quicker and aimed at the pads, Harmanpreet Kaur steps out and forces it toward deep mid-wicket for one more.
Flatter one outside off, this is chopped away through point for a single.
Tossed up around off, Harleen Deol lofts it over cover and picks up a couple of runs.
Slower through the air and around off, Kaur mistimes it toward cover.
Nagging length around off, Kaur looks to just guide it fine but misses.
Floated up on the pads, Harleen Deol sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Kaur steps out and drills it toward mid off. They go for the single and the fielder misses the direct hit at the bowler's end.
Around middle and leg, swept away past square leg for a single.

Leg bye! A tad shorter and on the pads, Harmanpreet Kaur nudges it toward leg gully and Harleen Deol calls her for the quick single. The keeper picks up the ball and has a shy at the batter's end but misses.
Quicker and flatter around off, kept out on the off side.
On a nagging length and at the pads, Harleen Deol misjudges the length and looks to step out but has to adjust and make the block.
A tad shorter and around off, punched away towards the cover region.
Good fielding! Nicely tossed up around off, Harleen Deol steps out and plays a lofted drive over mid off. Ayabonga Khaka there chases it down and keeps it down to a couple of runs.
Floated up full and on off stump, Deol strokes it toward extra cover.
This is on the pads, Harmanpreet Kaur turns it through mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Uppish but safe! Tossed up on off, Harleen Deol steps out and mistimes the lofted drive in front of mid off.
FIVE WIDES! This is spilled down the leg side, Deol misses the sweep and the keeper is beaten as well. The ball trickles into the fence.
On middle and leg, Kaur plays it off the back foot in front of mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and turning away, Harmanpreet Kaur cuts it off the back foot but straight to cover-point.
Excellent fielding! This is fuller and swept away firmly toward deep mid-wicket. Tazmin Brits there makes a sharp stop to her right with one hand and keeps it down to just a single.
Tossed up on off stump, Harleen Deol steps out and drills it straight to mid off.
A bit shorter and on the pads, Harleen Deol awkwardly fends it away.
There's a slight halt in the play as the physio is out to have a look at Harmanpreet Kaur. Kaur is looking a bit ginger but she feels good enough to continue.
Tossed up around off stump, Harleen Deol pushes it on the off side and gets across for the quick single. Laura Wolvaardt there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
This is on a nagging length around middle and Harmanpreet Kaur gets pinged on the back foot. Kaur manages to nudge it leg side for a single.
Nicely bowled! This is flighted on a length outside off, Kaur looks to come down the track but the ball turns away and takes the leading edge.
Full and on the pads, swept away nicely down to fine leg for one more.
Really full again and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it square of the wicket and firmly to deep cover for one.
Starts off with a full delivery on middle and leg, Harleen Deol pushes it down to long on for a single.

Drinks break! India Women are 43/2 at the halfway stage and it has been a decent enough recovery after a really sluggish start. South Africa Women have been brilliant thus far with the ball and in the field with Nonkululeko Mlaba leading the way with a couple of wickets. They will hope to pick up more wickets and restrict the Indians to an under-par total. Also, Sune Luus brings herself into the attack.

FOUR! Nicely bowled but it will be a boundary. Chloe Tryon tosses it up on off stump and Harmanpreet Kaur sets herself up for the hard-sweep. The ball turns away and just gets a feather of a top edge before running down to the vacant third-man fence.
Keeps the length short and bowls it outside off, Deol waits for it and slaps it to sweeper cover for just another single.
Short and outside off, Kaur rocks back and cuts it to deep point for a run.
Shorter and around off, this is punched away in front of covers for a single.

Beaten! Flatter delivery, close to the off stump, Harleen Deol backs away to cut but misses and there's a stifled appeal for caught behind and the bails also come off. The two umpires come together and decide that the bails were disturbed by the keeper's gloves.
Starts off with a shortish delivery around off, Harmanpreet Kaur waits on the back foot and plays it toward short third man for a quick single.
Chloe Tryon comes into the attack now.
Loops it up now on leg stump, Harmanpreet Kaur comes down the pitch and hits it to long on for one more.
Flatter one around off, Harleen Deol punches it through cover-point for one.
Nagging length around off, Kaur goes on the back foot and drives it through the cover-region for a single.
FOUR! Short and wide, Harmanpreet Kaur cuts it hard off the back foot and pierces the gap between point and cover-point for a boundary.
This is a bit fuller and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it toward deep backward square leg for a brace.
Just a fraction shorter and turning away from off stump, Harleen Deol hangs back and taps it through covers for one.
Nonkululeko Mlaba to continue.
Fuller and on middle, worked away past square leg for one.
Good length around off, Harleen Deol opens the face of the blade and plays it toward cover-point.
Length ball around middle, this is nudged away leg side for a quick single.
Pitched up at the stumps, Harmanpreet Kaur drills the straight drive but Nadine de Klerk just about gets a hand on it as the ball rolls toward mid on.
On a good length around off, angling in. Harmanpreet Kaur watchfully defends it out.
Fuller on middle and leg, Harleen Deol flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! On a good length and angling down the leg side, left alone for a wide.
Harleen Deol is the new batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! Nonkululeko Mlaba outsmarts Jemimah Rodrigues and picks up her second wicket of the game. This is nicely tossed up by Mlaba and she pushes it outside off as well. Jemimah Rodrigues steps out and looks to loft it over extra cover but gets undone in the flight and Sinalo Jafta is lightning quick to whips off the bails.
Commentary.Howout: st Sinalo Jafta b Nonkululeko Mlaba

Commentary.Commentary: Nicely bowled! This is flighted on a length and around off stump, Harleen Deol looks to come down the pitch but gets beaten in the flight and gets and outside edge toward short third man. Single taken.
Slower through the air and fuller as well on off stump, Harleen Deol pushes it back to the bowler.
A tad shorter and outside off, Harleen Deol plays it late but straight to short third man.
Pulls the length back and bowls it slower on middle and leg, Harleen Deol nudges it in front of mid-wicket.
Nonkululeko Mlaba comes back into the attack and starts off with a short ball on leg stump. Jemimah Rodrigues rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length on the body, Deol tucks it away to square leg. After the Powerplay, India Women are 19/1!
This is full and outside off, Harleen Deol looks for the cover drive but gets beaten past the outside edge.
No run, that is defended solidly off the front foot.
FOUR!
Four! The short ball is dispatched. Square cut played and the ball races towards the boundaryline.
No run, the off drive is played but it is stopped.
No run, the batter has just watchfully blocked this out.
FOUR!
Jemimah Rodrigues has just watchfully blocked this out.
Length ball at the stumps, Jemimah Rodrigues defends it out.
FOUR! Jemimah Rodrigues drives this through the covers and the ball races away to the fence.
Nadine de Klerk starts her spell with a fullish-length delivery around middle and gets the ball to shape away a bit. Jemimah Rodrigues strokes it towards cover.
Keeps it back of a length and bowls it around off, Harleen Deol just eases it toward backward point.
Back of a length around off, Harleen Deol hangs back and dabs it down toward short third man.
At the stumps and pushed out by Deol.
Length again around middle, Harleen Deol clips it straight to mid-wicket.
Back of a length around off, this is played off the back foot on the off side for a single.
Ayabonga Khaka comes into the attack and starts off with a length ball at the stumps. Jemimah Rodrigues blocks it out.
Good shot for no run. This is full and straight, Deol drives it straight to mid on. Still, no runs conceded off the bat by Shabnim Ismail.
That has zipped through! Banged in short and outside off, the ball hits the deck and zips through as Harleen Deol makes a leave.

Leg bye! Goes full now and tries to attack the pads, Jemimah Rodrigues looks to flick it away but misses. The ball goes off the pads and toward backward square leg. There is a stifled appeal for lbw but the batters cross for a leg bye.
A touch fuller and around middle, Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
A bit of yes and no but no harm is done. Length ball around middle, Jemimah Rodrigues forces it to mid on and looks for the single but decides against it.
Good length around middle, Jemimah Rodrigues tucks it to mid-wicket.
Harleen Deol is in at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Nonkululeko Mlaba sends Smriti Mandhana packing for a duck and she is delighted. Mlaba flights it up on a length and on middle and leg stump. Mandhana dances down the track and looks to heave it across the line but gets completely betaen in the flight. The ball turns in a bit as well and crashes into the leg stump. South Africa Women with a big early breakthrough here.
Flatter one around off, Smriti Mandhana cuts it straight to point.
Jemimah Rodrigues and India Women are finally off the mark! Tossed up around middle, Rodrigues heaves it uppishly toward the mid-wicket region and picks up a single.
Short and wide, Jemimah Rodrigues cuts it hard off the back foot but fails to get it through.
Nicely bowled! Flighted delivery, drifted onto middle and this one turns away after pitching. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to defend off the front foot but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Starts off with a looped-up delivery, full and outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues just leaves it alone for the keeper to collect.
Nonkululeko Mlaba to operate from the other end.
A maiden to begin with! Hard length around the off stump, Smriti Mandhana chops it straight towards point.
Five dots in a row to start with! A good bumper now from Shabnim Ismail, over the stumps and Smriti Mandhana does well to get her head out of the way.
Short of a length in that channel around off and angling across. Smriti Mandhana backs away and chops it in front of the gully region.
Back of a length and over middle, Smriti Mandhana hops on the back foot and keeps it out in front of covers.
Keeps it short and outside off, Smriti Mandhana hangs deep in her crease and eases it down to backward point.

Starts off with a shortish delivery angling across the left-hander. Smriti Mandhana stands tall and taps it to the right of backward point. Laura Wolvaardt there makes a sharp stop and seems to have hurt her fingers. Laura is off the field along with the physio and hopefully, she is fine.

Done with the pre-game formalities and it is now time to get the ball rolling. The two umpires make their way out to the middle and the South Africa Women's team is seen in a huddle before taking the field as well. It will be Jemimah Rodrigues to open the innings for India Women alongside Smriti Mandhana. Shabnim Ismail has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

We are just a few minutes away from the start of the game. But first, the two sets of players will line up for their respective national anthems. It will be India's national anthem first, followed by the national anthem of South Africa.

Jemimah Rodrigues is up for a quick chat as well. She says that the week has been pretty good and they have gotten a decent amount of break between games as well. Adds that the series has given the opportunity to try out different players and tweak the lineup as well. On opening the batting, she says that there's not much difference between opening and batting at number 3 and it is all about doing her best. Mentions that even though it is a final they only want to follow the process regardless of the win or loss.

Laura Wolvaardt is down for a quick chat. She says that it will be a great match today. Adds that preparation is key and this is probably the last game before the World Cup that will give them clarity. Says that she hopes to take some good form into the World Cup. Adds that she is excited to have home support at the upcoming World Cup and is ready to perform in front of her family and friends as well.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Yastika Bhatia (WK), Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Harleen Deol, Jemimah Rodrigues, Devika Vaidya, Deepti Sharma, Pooja Vastrakar, Renuka Singh, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, and Sneh Rana (In for Shikha Pandey).

South Africa Women (Playing XI) - Tazmin Brits, Laura Wolvaardt, Lara Goodall (In for Marizanne Kapp), Sune Luus (C), Chloe Tryon, Annerie Dercksen, Nadine de Klerk, Sinalo Jafta (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Ayabonga Khaka (In for Tumi Sekhukhune), and Nonkululeko Mlaba.
TOSS - India Women have won the toss and they will BAT first.

South Africa Women, on the other hand, defeated the Windies Women twice but lost the opening fixture of the series to India Women. Marizanne Kapp has been their top player with the bat. However, she might miss this game due to personal reasons. Laura Wolvaardt and skipper Sune Luus have been in decent touch too. Masabata Klaas has been their top wicket-taker with 5 scalps while Nonkululeko Mlaba has supported her well with 4 wickets to her name. They have been good in their own backyard and will be looking to get over the mighty Women in Blue in the Final before the mega event. Who will come out on top in this big game? We shall find out soon. Toss and team news coming up shortly. Stay tuned!

It is time for the final of the Women's T20I Tri-Series in South Africa, where the hosts will be taking on India Women at Buffalo Park. The Women in Blue have dominated this series so far and are unbeaten coming into the final. Their top three, Jemimah Rodrigues, Smriti Mandhana, and Harmanpreet Kaur, have all got runs under their belts, but their middle order hasn't been tested that much except for their first game, where they fared well. Deepti Sharma is the leading wicket-taker with eight wickets in four matches, while Renuka Singh, Pooja Vastrakar, and Shikha Pandey form a decent pace trio. They will be oozing with confidence and will hope to maintain that unbeaten record and lift the trophy. The Proteas Women, on the other hand, defeated the Windies in both games but fell short against India, with one game also being rained out. Marizanne Kapp leads the team in runs, with Laura Wolvaardt close behind. Sune Luus and Chloe Tryon hold their middle order, while Nonkululeko Mlaba has been their best performer with the ball. Ayabonga Khaka and Masabata Klaas have played a good supporting role as well. This series has also provided the opportunity for all three teams to find out more about their teams and combinations, which will help them in the upcoming Women's T20 World Cup. South Africa Women will have the home crowd cheering for them, which should serve as extra motivation for them to put their best foot forward and get their hands on the trophy. Will they be able to avenge their previous loss and win the series? Or will India Women continue their dominance? Let's find out together.
